info.title: OpenTrust Management API
info.description: Publish and synchronize the provider's organization profile, compliance, resources, subprocessors, machine-readable JSON, internal knowledge, logos, and vulnerabilities. Every operation, including GET, requires an organization-issued Management Bearer key with the documented scope. Consumer keys and session cookies cannot authorize this interface. Read and write scopes are independent. JSON bodies are limited to 2 MB. Lists use data and nextCursor (limit 50, maximum 100). Data responses use private, no-store caching. Existing /api/v1 publishing and knowledge routes remain compatibility aliases and enforce Management key audience for Bearer access.

put.summary: Create or replace a machine-readable document
put.description: Upsert by organization and stable slug (up to 100 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; no .json suffix). Supply exactly one of payload (any JSON value) or payloadText (JSON source as a string). Use payloadText to preserve formatting and numeric precision. Omitted visibility defaults to restricted; other omitted metadata resets to defaults. Public documents appear on the public trust page. schemaUrl is an informational reference and does not cause a remote fetch or schema validation.

put.summary: PUT a raw JSON file without changing access or URLs
put.description: Send the JSON document itself as the request body with Content-Type: application/json. Source text, numeric precision, whitespace, and key ordering are preserved. Replaces the payload of an existing configured document, retaining its metadata, access level, ID, creation date, and stable URLs. Missing documents return 404; invalid JSON leaves the previous payload unchanged. Limit: 2 MB. Success returns an enveloped management record.

post.description: Management only. Supply exactly one of body, sourceKnowledgeId, sourceMachineReadableSlug or sourceResourceId in JSON. Policy metadata and extracted text share one record. Publishing is explicit; source changes do not silently alter existing versions.

get.description: Consumer interface derives agency/account filters from the authenticated identity; request-supplied agency filters cannot broaden access. Management interface exports the organization. Daily UTC summaries are updated atomically on access and retained for at least six calendar months after day end. prepared means a response was prepared, not received or read. Follow nextCursor until null. Missing rows do not prove no gaps.
